task.title: Prefer certain nodes using preferredDuringScheduling node affinity weights
task.shortdesc: Configure soft node preferences so the scheduler favors matching nodes while still allowing fallback placement.

step.cmd: Decide which label indicates preferred nodes (for example, "spot=false" or "zone=us-east-1a").
Create one or more preference entries with a "weight" (1-100) and a "preference.matchExpressions" rule.
Apply the manifest and observe placement across nodes when preferred capacity is available versus constrained.
Adjust weights or add additional preferences to reflect priority among multiple preferred attributes.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
